blocks.text: JAKARTA – Roadside snack seller Doddy watches Jakarta’s traffic crawl past his stall. The thought of soaring above the capital in a helicopter makes him laugh. “Of course, I would love to see Jakarta from above. Everyone down below will look like tiny ants, right?” said the 45-year-old, who sells gorengan, or fried snacks, speaking to The Straits Times. “My heart might just stop from the excitement.” It might just become a reality as Jakarta Governor Pramono Anung wants TransJakarta, the city’s public bus operator, to venture into boat services and eventually air transport.
